name: nomic-embed-bns-legal
context_scaling: Inherited unchanged from nomic-ai/nomic-embed-text-v1.5 (config.json max_position_embeddings 2048). This derivative does not publish a context-extension recipe of its own.
attention_variant: bidirectional encoder (nomic_bert: BERT + rotary, GLU MLP)
notes: ADDED 2026-10-29. A finetune of nomic-ai/nomic-embed-text-v1.5, not a new base model: same config.json, same 0.137 parameters (identical tensor set). Recorded as a contender because it publishes benchmark evidence against its own base; the evidence rows below are card-sourced and marked vendor_claim. Licence apache-2.0, repo created 2026-06-16.

benchmarks.name: Triplet accuracy, held-out 580 triplets (%)
benchmarks.config: Card 'Results' table, 'Triplet accuracy' column: Base nomic-embed-text-v1.5 0.9552 vs this model 0.9983 (x100). Eval split = 5% of 11,587 synthesized contrastive triplets, seed 42, fp32. Card states it uses one curated hard negative per query, so it is a sanity signal rather than end-to-end RAG recall.
